name: Anaheim Harbor Blvd (Across from Disneyland Main Entrance) Panera Bread Chicken Noodle Soup, Sourdough & IHOP Pancakes/Eggs
brandOrRestaurant: Panera Bread & IHOP (S. Harbor Blvd · Directly Across from Disneyland Esplanade)
whyItWorks: Literally a 3-minute walk across the Harbor Blvd crosswalk from the Disneyland & DCA turnstiles, Panera Bread (Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup, Sourdough Bread Bowl, Turkey Sandwich) and IHOP (Scrambled Eggs & Pancakes) give you a 24/7 flare-safe safety net on arrival or late at night.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stop at Panera on Harbor Blvd for a bowl of Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup with Country Sourdough bread or a Deli Turkey Sandwich on Sourdough to bring right into the parks (Disneyland allows outside food!).
watchOuts: Avoid Panera's Charged Lemonades/Citrus Refreshers and broccoli cheddar soup (unless taking lactase)
